subject: Business
title: Good Debt vs. Bad Debt
description: A quick win: understand Good Debt vs. Bad Debt.

hook.text: A student borrows $40,000 for a degree that doubles their income. A shopper borrows $5,000 for clothes.

buildup.text: Good debt finances assets that grow in value or increase earning power. Bad debt finances depreciating consumption.

discovery.text: Mortgages on rental properties and business loans are typically good debt. Credit card balances on wants are bad debt.

twist.text: Even good debt becomes bad if the terms are wrong. A 15% interest student loan on a low-earning degree destroys value.

climax.text: The wealthy use leverage — borrowing to invest in assets that return more than the interest costs.

punchline.text: Borrow to build wealth. Never borrow to look wealthy.

quiz.question: What makes debt 'good'?
options: It finances assets that grow in value or increase earning power
It has a low monthly payment

details.summary: Good debt finances assets that appreciate or increase earning potential, like education loans or business investments. Bad debt finances depreciating consumption like credit card purchases for lifestyle items. The distinction depends on whether the debt generates a positive return.
details.whyItMatters: Not all debt is equal. Strategically using leverage to acquire appreciating assets or boost income can accelerate wealth building, while consumer debt at high interest rates traps people in a cycle of paying for the past.
takeaways: Good debt finances appreciating assets or increases your earning power
Bad debt funds depreciating purchases with high interest rates
The key distinction is whether the debt generates returns exceeding its cost

faq.question: Are student loans considered good debt?
faq.answer: It depends on the return on investment. A degree that significantly increases lifetime earnings at reasonable interest rates is good debt. An expensive degree in a low-paying field with massive borrowed amounts can become bad debt if income never matches the obligation.

faq.question: Is a mortgage good debt or bad debt?
faq.answer: Generally good debt because real estate typically appreciates and you build equity over time while locking in housing costs. However, buying more house than you can afford or during a price bubble can make mortgage debt problematic if property values decline.
